entries:
Alpha 1.9.30 (beyond the four lanterns)

  • The Dark Realm opens: At level 100, after manually completing all four crystal repairs, speak to the Dungeon Guide to enter a shared expedition zone. Recover at the Resonant Foothold with town-style healing and Well Rested, then explore the Unwritten Shore, Tithe of Names, Stillwater Foundry and City Without Tomorrow.
  • A longer Fourfold Chronicle: 24 new chapters and 38 discoveries reveal the people behind Malachar's promises. Investigate records, fight collectors and recover four new personal quest items with bag icons. Ilyra offers and completes chapters through explicit conversations; Maelin and five other residents have optional, discovery-led dialogue.
  • A road to the throne: New entrants must complete the expedition before entering the Umbral Nexus, whose clear leads to the Dark King's raid. Existing accepted Nexus or finale contracts retain their access at level 100; missing added chapters are optional for those veterans, never automatically completed. The map marks accepted discoveries and Recall returns you to Lanternhold.
  • Progression tuning: Incoming combat XP and newly offered daily-quest XP are lower, targeting approximately 100 hours to level 100. Saved levels, XP, gear, Gold and accepted reward quotes are preserved. Quest XP still becomes Resonance XP at level 100. The 100-hour and additional 8–12-hour Dark Realm targets are estimates under continued tuning, not measured guarantees.
  • Reliable return: Ilyra's expedition projection stays available, and Recall/re-entry synchronizes movement so approaching her and turning in quests works correctly. Admin visits inside the shared realm respect personal entry requirements and actual scenery. Private dungeon and raid checkpoints and the 15-minute logout expiry are unchanged.
  • Release identity: The published browser manifest now takes its version from the same release file as the project, preventing an outdated deployment label from disagreeing with the login screen.
  • Integration continues: The opening expedition chapter and fresh-character opening have passed connected checks; the complete campaign, remaining raids and final pacing still need acceptance. This is not the final 1.10 sign-off. Earlier patch notes remain available.

Alpha 1.9.29 (hold the ground you earned)

  • Boss checkpoints: Returning from town to an active dungeon or raid now places you at the latest cleared boss checkpoint. Before the first boss clear, you return to the entrance. The Dungeon Guide explains the return rule.
  • Your party keeps its progress: Re-entry preserves cleared encounters and rewards, does not skip uncleared rooms, and leaves teammates already inside in place. Scene loading uses the server's actual checkpoint position.
  • Existing limits remain: The 15-minute logout expiry and active-run reset rules are unchanged. This release does not rebalance XP or add the planned expanded Dark Realm story; those remain part of the ongoing 1.10 work. Earlier patch notes remain available.

Alpha 1.9.28 (the same foes await)

  • Consistent restored encounters: Current seeded dungeon and raid runs now restore the original enemy pack composition, placement and combat profiles after a server restart, instead of substituting generic room packs.
  • Saved progress stays yours: Cleared rooms stay cleared. Saved geometry, quest credit and the 15-minute logout expiry are unchanged. Older or unmatched layouts retain their compatible restoration path; no boss health or damage tuning is included.
  • Integration continues: Full campaign and raid acceptance remain in progress; this is not the final 1.10 sign-off. Earlier patch notes remain available.

Alpha 1.9.27 (back where you belong)

  • Reliable dungeon reconnects: Returning to an active dungeon or raid now carries your saved landing position through scene loading, preventing an intermittent reset to the entrance that could separate party members.
  • Your run rules stay the same: The existing 15-minute logout expiry, uncleared encounter restoration, resources and quest rewards are unchanged. This update does not grant dungeon completion or change boss balance.
  • Integration continues: Full campaign and raid acceptance remain in progress; this is not the final 1.10 sign-off. Earlier patch notes remain available.

Alpha 1.9.26 (the right moment to answer)

  • Service hints keep pace: Interaction distance hints refresh as you walk, even when the pointer stays still. Entering or leaving an instance clears old town prompts and cursor highlights.
  • Meet Orun at the encounter: The Dark King's opening Eidolon callout now waits until a living raider approaches the encounter, instead of playing at the distant entrance portal. Later phase aid and boss combat balance are unchanged.
  • Integration continues: Earned campaign and full raid checks remain in progress; this is not the final 1.10 sign-off. All earlier patch notes remain available.

Alpha 1.9.25 (a clear path to storage)

  • Reach the west-side stash: The coffer now sits in the clear gap beside the Trading House, outside the blacksmith and away from the casino door. Normal clicking or tapping can reach it; building collisions and interaction distance are unchanged.
  • Complete rejection history: Administration history now records requests rejected because another connection replaced the submitting session, or because an authenticated request exceeded payload or rate limits. Unsafe request streams are disconnected; retrying the same operation still cannot duplicate a grant.
  • Explicit outage recovery: If both activity storage paths fail, changes are refused, the connection closes and health reports pending audit recovery. Rejected events are retained in memory until storage returns; this is not crash-durable storage and never counts as a successful character change.
  • Integration continues: Remaining earned campaign and group-raid checks are still in progress. Earlier releases and their patch notes remain available.

Alpha 1.9.24 (a grander Lanternhold Casino)

  • Two full gaming floors: Explore equally spacious public and VIP halls. Stairs switch floors completely, with no upstairs patrons, furniture or effects visible from downstairs. Each floor has 4 blackjack tables, 4 Hold’em tables, 2 roulette tables, 4 baccarat tables and 32 themed slot machines.
  • Roulette and baccarat: Join shared, timed rounds with persistent seats and a dealer, one-click wagers, optional multi-bet slips, animated reveals and clear saved winnings. Change your stake between rounds. Single-zero roulette supports inside and outside bets; baccarat follows standard drawing rules with 5% Banker commission.
  • Keep your winnings: Confirmed wagers and payouts recover after disconnects and server restarts. Public games use Gold; VIP games use EP. Limits remain 100,000 Gold or 100 EP per round, with no EP-to-Gold conversion or gameplay-power rewards.
  • Automatic administrator VIP: Administrators receive VIP access and 100 EP monthly. Durable receipts prevent repeat grants or stacking the same month's normal VIP allowance. No payment integration has been added.
  • Dependable administration history: Requests deferred by character, trading, casino or operation-storage recovery now retain a sanitized audit entry, without duplicating grants when the same request is retried.
  • A clearer town entrance: The stash sits west toward the Trading House, clear of the casino door. The entrance is labeled Lanternhold Casino and retains its clickable entry dialogue.
  • Integration continues: Remaining campaign and group-raid checks are still in progress. This release is not full 1.10 sign-off.

Alpha 1.9.23 (history that survives an outage)

  • More dependable administration history: Rejected malformed requests, conflicting request IDs and failed role lookups now retain their audit entries in the durable activity journal when the database is unavailable. The original entries are restored when storage recovers, including after a server restart.
  • Still fail closed: Rejected requests grant nothing. Permissions, item and Gold rules, and successful-operation replay protection are unchanged. If both storage paths fail, the panel still reports that activity storage is unavailable.
  • Integration continues: The remaining earned campaign and group-raid checks remain in progress. This maintenance patch is not full 1.10 sign-off.

Alpha 1.9.22 (keep your party in sight)

  • Four-player party visibility: Full dungeon parties now use a compact two-column roster. All four health bars and the party heading stay visible while ready checks, loot settings and invitations scroll separately.
  • Keep control: Healing selection and leader actions remain available. Smaller parties, larger raid layouts and phone controls are unchanged.
  • Campaign progress: The earned Wizard route through Verdant now passes with a four-player party, manual rewards and saved Water handoff. Remaining realms, raids and final 1.10 checks are still in progress; this is not full campaign sign-off.

Alpha 1.9.21 (the whole raid in view)

  • Every health bar counts: Desktop parties with five or more members now use a compact two-column raid roster. At the standard 1280×720 layout, all ten health bars fit above chat without scrolling, including both healers in a five-player group.
  • Healing stays within reach: Healing-target selection and its clear button remain available alongside raid roles, readiness and leader controls. Four-player parties and phone controls are unchanged.
  • Less deployment waiting: Independent hosted checks now run alongside each other, with browser work distributed more evenly. All release gates and test coverage remain in place.
  • Final integration continues: The full 1.10 campaign, group-raid and physical-phone checks remain in progress.
